shows.title: Star Trek Legacy / Haunted Prisons
shows.first_half: First Half: September 8, 2026, marked the 60th anniversary of Star Trek. Rod Roddenberry, son of creator Gene Roddenberry, will reflect on his father’s life and vision, share personal memories of his parents, and discuss carrying their legacy forward. He’ll also explore the story behind the original USS Enterprise model, the Roddenberry Foundation, and the future of the Star Trek universe.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Paranormal investigator and author Ross Allison will share compelling encounters from some of America’s most haunted prisons, and explain why these locations are considered paranormal hotspots.

shows.title: Psychic Crime Solving / Astrology Forecast
shows.first_half: First Half: Psychic medium Chuck Bergman will reveal how he discovered his psychic abilities and developed them during military service and 32 years in law enforcement. He’ll share stories of using his gifts in criminal investigations and explain how mediumship works, including spirit communication.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Intuitive astrologer Maria Shaw will explore the astrology of Halloween and beyond, offering predictions for 2027, a year she believes could bring significant change for us all. She’ll also examine the link between astrology and the paranormal, revealing which zodiac signs may be most likely to see ghosts.

shows.title: UFO Crash Retrievals / Negative Entities
shows.first_half: First Half: Engineer and UFO researcher Ryan S. Wood will explore UFO crash retrievals, the controversial Majestic Twelve documents, and claims of recovered nonhuman technology. He’ll discuss key witnesses and historical cases, alleged government reverse-engineering programs, and UFOdex, his AI-powered platform for analyzing UFO archives.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Psychic medium and author June Lundgren will examine the hierarchy of negative entities, how she believes they operate, and what draws them to people, places, and objects. She’ll reveal signs of spiritual attachments and ways to protect yourself and seek help.

shows.title: Physical Mediumship / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Joining guest host Rich Berra (email), physical and mental medium, author, and speaker Julie Adreani will discuss her work in physical mediumship under red light. She’ll explore the role of a trusted, dedicated circle and describe séance phenomena, including transfiguration and other forms of spirit activity. She'll also share her journey into mediumship, her training, and personal encounters involving spirits and extraterrestrials. Followed by Open Lines in the latter half. Give Rich a call and discuss whatever is on your mind!
